title: /kb-ingest cites tool-native maps and symbol pointers
goal: /kb-ingest step 4 (what is worth a fact) takes interfaces, dependencies and entry points from the pins and, when available, the kbingest map output and ctags JSON or a language server; it writes a CODE fact only for a claim that matters outside source browsing (an interface, contract, entry point, generated output, security or persistence behaviour), never one per symbol; each CODE fact cites the file, the symbol as path#symbol and the map relation it rests on; the toolchain pins go on the repository's source row, never on a fact; a later ingest of a new commit reports each fact whose evidence moved, changed or disappeared as a finding and rewrites none; the skill names agents/codebase-mapping.md and windows/powershell-static-analysis.md as the facts it relies on; the change router test still passes.
